Projektbeschreibung:

Technologie begeistert Sie? Uns auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Messtechnik suchen wir nach Mitarbeitern in der Software-Entwicklung für AI-gestützte Prüfmittelentwicklung (m/w/x) in Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie persönlich kennenzulernen – und gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft und Teamgeist an spannenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien zu arbeiten.


Aufgaben:

  • Mit Ihrer Passion für moderne Software- und AI-Entwicklung wirken Sie in einem interdisziplinären Team an einer digitalen Plattform zur strukturierten Testbeschreibung im Prüfmittelentwicklungsprozess mit
  • Sie entwickeln und erweitern eine Web-Plattform, die als zentrale Grundlage dient, um Tests zu beschreiben, zu generieren, zu parametrisieren sowie Limits, Messunsicherheiten und weitere prüfrelevante Informationen an Testprogramme zu übertragen
  • Dabei bringen Sie Ihr tiefgreifendes Informatik-Know-how ein, um skalierbare, modulare und wartbare Softwarelösungen zu schaffen, die eng mit der bestehenden R&S-Infrastruktur gekoppelt sind
  • Sie beschäftigen sich intensiv mit modernen AI-Technologien, insbesondere Large Language Models, Multi-Agenten-Systemen und aktuellen Modell-Benchmarks, und bewerten deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Kontext der Prüfmittelentwicklung
  • Mit Ihrem Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen und Entwicklungsprozesse tragen Sie dazu bei, AI-gestützte Workflows für die Erstellung, Verwaltung und Nutzung von Testbeschreibungen zu konzipieren und umzusetzen
  • Sie unterstützen die Anbindung der Plattform an bestehende Systeme, insbesondere zur Archivierung der erzeugten Plattformdaten im PDM-Umfeld, z. B. für Process Associated Documents
  • Gemeinsam mit Fachexperten aus Entwicklung, Fertigung, Prüfmittelentwicklung und IT analysieren Sie Anforderungen, überführen diese in tragfähige technische Konzepte und setzen diese in qualitativ hochwertige Softwarelösungen um
  • Sie verifizieren die von Ihnen entwickelten Funktionen, begleiten deren Einführung in den operativen Einsatz und treiben die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Plattform proaktiv voran
  • Je nach Erfahrung übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, koordinieren technische Abstimmungen und begleiten die Übergabe neuer Funktionen an Anwender und Stakeholder

Qualifikationen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, technischen Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Software Engineering oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Fundierte Programmierkenntnisse in modernen Softwaretechnologien, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in Web-Entwicklung, Backend-Services, APIs, Datenmodellen und Softwarearchitekturen
  • Intensive praktische Auseinandersetzung mit AI-Entwicklung, insbesondere mit Large Language Models, Prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Agentic Workflows oder Multi-Agenten-Systemen
  • Erfahrung in der Bewertung und Nutzung aktueller AI-Modelle und Benchmarks sowie die Fähigkeit, deren Stärken, Grenzen und Einsatzpotenziale für industrielle Entwicklungsprozesse einzuordnen
  • Vorteilhaft sind Kenntnisse im Bereich Prüfmittelentwicklung, Testautomatisierung, Mess- und Prüftechnik oder in der Entwicklung von Testsystemen für elektronische Baugruppen und Geräte
  • Verständnis für strukturierte Testbeschreibungen, Parametrisierung von Tests, Grenzwertdefinitionen, Messunsicherheiten oder vergleichbare technische Datenmodelle ist von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Datenmanagement, Dokumentenablage, PDM/PLM-Systemen oder der Integration von Softwarelösungen in bestehende Unternehmensinfrastrukturen ist wünschenswert
  • Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge in robuste, nutzerorientierte Softwarelösungen zu überführen
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Teamfähigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Eigeninitiative sowie eine strukturierte, selbstständige und kooperative Arbeitsweise

Benefits:

  • Kollegiales und freundschaftliches Arbeitsklima

data.description:
Unsere Vision

Storytellarr wird die #1 Agentur für Creator-Led Growth im B2B in Europa. Wir bringen Creator-Marketing und Personal Branding in B2B-Software- und KI-Firmen. So bauen sie einen neuen Marketingkanal auf und werden über authentische Menschen und Stimmen im Markt sichtbar.

Gleichzeitig bauen wir Storytellarr selbst zur Medienmarke aus: mit Newsletter, Videopodcast, Blog, Eventreihen und den eigenen Personal Brands unseres Teams. Dabei suchen wir dich!

Die Rolle

Du wirst die rechte Hand unserer CEO. Dein Schwerpunkt ist kreative Arbeit: Du bringst Ideen, Storytelling und ein Gespür dafür mit, was im Feed funktioniert.

KI ist dabei dein Werkzeug. Damit setzt du deine Ideen schnell und effizient um. Bei jeder Aufgabe fragst du dich, wie sie sich mit KI besser lösen lässt, und baust dir deine eigenen Workflows.

Deine Aufgaben

Content für Kund:innen und für Storytellarr

  • Du schreibst hochperformante LinkedIn-Posts, vor allem für unsere CEO und für unsere Kund:innen.

  • Du gestaltest Visuals im jeweiligen Brand-Design.

  • Du hilfst bei Video-Content, zum Beispiel beim Erstellen von UGC Videos.

Unser Blog

  • Du verantwortest den Aufbau des Storytellarr-Blogs.

  • Du optimierst ihn für KI-Suche (GEO), damit uns auch KI-Agenten finden. Das Know-how dazu lernst du von uns.

Unsere Medienmarke

  • Du bereitest unsere Newsletter mit vor.

  • Du unterstützt bei Videopodcast und Events.

  • Du managst die Community unserer CEO auf LinkedIn aktiv mit.

Unser Creator-Netzwerk

  • Du baust unsere Creator-Datenbank weiter aus. Mit diesen B2B-Creatorn arbeiten wir auf unseren Kundenprojekten.

  • Du recherchierst neue Creator, schreibst sie an und gewinnst sie für unseren Pool.

  • Du baust auch unser B2B UGC Creator Netzwerk weiter aus.

Deine eigene Personal Brand

  • Du baust deine eigene Personal Brand auf LinkedIn oder Instagram auf.

  • Du produzierst Content, der auch unter der Storytellarr-Brand funktioniert, und trittst dabei selbst vor die Kamera.

Backoffice (kleiner Teil)

  • Du hilfst, die Buchhaltung sauber zu halten, etwa indem du Belege den Transaktionen zuordnest.

Was du mitbringst

Wir suchen keine Routine, wir suchen frische Ideen. Du musst Dinge nicht schon hundertmal gemacht haben. Wichtig ist, wie du an Neues herangehst und das du den nötigen Drive mitbringst.

  • Du hast ein Growth-Mindset und richtig Bock, mit KI zu lernen.

  • Du bist hands-on und kommst schnell ins Doing.

  • Wenn etwas unklar ist, löst du das Problem, probierst aus und experimentierst.

  • Du bist proaktiv und denkst selbst an deine Themen, ohne erinnert zu werden.

  • Du hast Lust, unternehmerisch zu denken, vielleicht sogar irgendwann selbst zu gründen, und willst dabei von einer Seriengründerin lernen.

Das brauchst du

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in.

  • Du hast ein Content-Mindset und schon selbst Content erstellt, zum Beispiel auf TikTok oder mit einem eigenen Kanal.

  • Du kannst Geschichten erzählen, ob im Text oder im Video.

  • Du hast schon mit ChatGPT, Claude oder ähnlichen Tools gearbeitet und dir idealerweise eigene Aufgaben automatisiert.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und stehst gern vor der Kamera.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch fließend und arbeitest auch bei Routineaufgaben sorgfältig.

Das ist ein Plus

  • Du hast KI schon in der Content-Erstellung eingesetzt, etwa beim Videoschnitt oder in Canva.

  • Du hast dir eine eigene Reichweite aufgebaut.

  • Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst zu Content-Recordings und Coworking vor Ort sein.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Direkt an der Gründerin: Du lernst täglich von unserer CEO, einer Serial Founderin und Expertin für LinkedIn, GTM und B2B-Sales.

  • Eine Medienmarke von Anfang an: Du baust Blog, Newsletter, Podcast und Events mit auf und siehst, was dein Content bewirkt.

  • KI-Know-how: Du lernst, deine Arbeit mit eigenen KI-Workflows zu automatisieren.

  • Spannende Kund:innen: Du arbeitest mit Software- und KI-Firmen aus dem DACH-Raum und mit B2B-Creatorn.

  • Flexibilität: Du arbeitest remote an festen Tagen, die wir mit deinem Studium abstimmen. Dazu kommen Coworking-Tage und Content-Recordings in Berlin.

Ablauf

  • Kurzes Kennenlernen per Video, 20 Minuten

  • Case Study: Du bekommst eine kleine Casestudy die du lösen sollst

  • Längeres Interview: Du stellst deine Case Study vor und wir lernen uns besser kennen

Du liest das und denkst: That's me? Dann come to us!

data.description:
Die DAM GmbH ist bereits seit 2005 der Prozessdienstleister für Energieversorgungsunternehmen. Für unsere Kunden erbringen wir alle Prozessdienstleistungen, die es ihnen ermöglichen, erfolgreich im deutschen Markt agieren zu können.

Und wir wachsen weiter!

Zur Verstärkung seines Teams IT-Infrastruktur sucht Heiko Seidler Sie als

IT-Administrator Infrastruktur & Cloud (m/w/d/x)

unbefristet, in Vollzeit, ab sofort am Standort Magdeburg.

In dieser Position übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für unsere IT-Infrastruktur und gestalten aktiv den Ausbau moderner Cloud- und Hybridumgebungen mit. Sie sorgen gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Team für einen stabilen, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen Betrieb unserer Systeme.

Ihr Aufgabengebiet:

  • Sie administrieren, betreuen und entwickeln unsere gesamte IT-Infrastruktur kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Sie verantworten den Betrieb, die Konfiguration und das Monitoring unserer Netzwerkumgebung.

  • Sie administrieren und optimieren unsere Microsoft Exchange Umgebung (On-Premises und Exchange Online).

  • Sie betreuen und entwickeln unsere Microsoft Azure Umgebung sowie weitere Microsoft-365-Dienste weiter.

  • Sie verwalten und pflegen unsere Active-Directory- und Hybrid-AD-Umgebungen.

  • Sie installieren, konfigurieren und betreiben Microsoft-Windows-Server-Systeme.

  • Sie betreuen und optimieren unsere Sophos-XGS-Firewall-Infrastruktur.

  • Sie analysieren und beheben Störungen im Infrastruktur- und Serverumfeld.

  • Sie unterstützen bei Infrastruktur- und IT-Sicherheitsprojekten.

  • Sie erstellen und pflegen technische Dokumentationen.

  • Sie nehmen an der IT-Infrastruktur-Rufbereitschaft teil.

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Sie verfügen über praktische Erfahrung in der Administration von IT-Infrastrukturen.

  • Sie arbeiten selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.

  • Sie analysieren technische Probleme systematisch und finden nachhaltige Lösungen.

  • Sie bringen eine hohe Serviceorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Fachbereichen mit.

  • Sie sind bereit, an unserer IT-Rufbereitschaft teilzunehmen.

Idealerweise verfügen Sie bereits über Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche

  • Microsoft Azure und Microsoft 365

  • Active Directory und hybride Identitätslösungen

  • Microsoft Exchange bzw. Exchange Online

  • Microsoft Windows Server

  • Netzwerkadministration (DNS, DHCP, VLAN, Routing, Switching)

  • Sophos-XGS-Firewalls

  • IT-Sicherheit sowie Backup- und Recovery-Konzepte

Darüber freuen wir uns zusätzlich

  • Microsoft-Zertifizierungen (z. B. AZ-104 oder SC-300)

  • Erfahrungen mit VMware vSphere oder Microsoft Hyper-V

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Automatisierung mit PowerShell

10 gute Gründe, um für die DAM zu arbeiten:

  • Ein spannendes & vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet je nach Einsatzbereich.

  • Ein durchdachtes Onboarding, persönliche Mentoren und direkter Teamanschluss.

  • Flache Strukturen, transparente Kommunikation und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Moderne Büroarbeitsplätze.

  • Kostenlose Getränke und gesunde Snacks, Wertgutscheine zu besonderen Anlässen, kostenfreie Parkplätze und freies WLAN.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und individuelle Urlaubsplanung.

  • Unser Urlaubspaket besteht aus 30 Urlaubstagen plus halbe Tage Sonderurlaub an Heiligabend, Silvester und an Ihrem Firmenjubiläum – insgesamt 31,5 Tage Entspannung.

  • Wir schaffen unseren Mitarbeitenden Freiraum, um ihre Ideen und Themen zur persönlichen sowie beruflichen Weiterentwicklung.

  • Mit Business-Bike, Sportevents und Gesundheits-Workshops fördern wir Wohlbefinden und Fitness – für ein starkes und gesundes Team.

  • Ob After-Work, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier – gemeinsame Events stärken den Teamgeist und sorgen für unvergessliche Momente.

Klingt das nach einer Perspektive, die zu Ihnen passt?

Wenn ja, freuen wir uns, wenn Sie den nächsten Schritt gehen möchten.

Weitere Informationen zu Arbeiten bei der DAM finden Sie auf unserer Internetseite.

data.description:
Become a Part of Accurids

Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data!

At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our platform identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in line with ISO IDMP and other global standards. Leading pharma companies and health authorities rely on it for product data, regulatory submissions and supply chain transparency.

In this role, you are the person our customers turn to when they want to get IDMP right. You lead projects end to end, bring the pharma perspective into our product, and support our sales team as the domain expert in conversations with prospects.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • You lead customer projects from requirements and solution design through pilots and proofs of concept to rollout and user training.
  • You advise customers on ISO IDMP, related standards, data models, governance and integration.
  • You analyse business processes and data flows and turn them into clear, standardized structures.
  • You translate customer needs into feature specifications for our product team and help shape the roadmap.
  • You support sales as a domain expert in demos, prospect workshops and conferences.
  • You follow regulatory and standards developments.

What helps you succeed:

  • Several years of experience in the pharma industry, for example in regulatory affairs, clinical, manufacturing, supply chain or R&D.
  • Hands-on IDMP experience, ideally from implementation projects.
  • You have led customer or internal projects and can show their results.
  • You structure complex data questions well and explain them clearly to experts and management.
  • You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit.
  • Business-fluent English. German is a plus.
  • It’s a plus if you have experience with data governance or MDM.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Salary range of €70,000 to €105,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • Our office in the KölnTurm with a stunning view over Cologne and free parking
  • Hybrid working, so you can combine office days with working from home
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Personal learning budget for conferences, trainings and certifications
  • Your choice of a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a City Plus Card with €50 per month
  • Real influence on a product used by top pharma companies, with a direct line to leadership
  • A team of around 20 people with high trust and flat hierarchies

Not ticking every box?

Apply anyway! We care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn than about a perfect checklist.

At Accurids, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented groups in tech, science and data to apply.

Wir entwickeln das Wertpapiergeschäft der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe weiter und schaffen ein neues digitales Neo-Brokerage-Angebot. Es richtet sich gezielt an junge, digital-affine Zielgruppen, die wir für unsere Finanzgruppe gewinnen wollen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit einem zukunftsweisenden Mobile-First-Angebot, bestehend aus einer leistungsstarken Brokerage-App, einem unverwechselbaren Marktauftritt mit erstklassigem Service und nahtlosem Zugang zu persönlicher Beratung unserer Primärbanken eine starke Antwort auf den sich wandelnden Brokerage-Markt zu geben. Dabei vereinen wir die Dynamik eines Start-ups mit der Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Bei uns hast Du die einzigartige Chance, ein innovatives Angebot von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten – von der Markenentwicklung über die User Experience bis zum Produktdesign. Flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsweisen erlauben dir schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Das baust du mit uns auf

Ein wirksames Compliance- und Risikomanagement schafft die Grundlage dafür, dass unser Unternehmen innerhalb klarer regulatorischer und risikobezogener Grenzen handelt. Als Head of Compliance & Risikomanagement verantwortest du beide Funktionen in der zweiten Verteidigungslinie der Bank. Du stellst sicher, dass die relevanten gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und aufsichtsrechtlichen Anforderungen eingehalten werden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Bereich identifizierst, bewertest, steuerst und überwachst du sämtliche Risiken. Dabei sicherst du die jederzeitige Risikotragfähigkeit und sorgst dafür, dass Risiken bewusst, angemessen und innerhalb der vom Management festgelegten Grenzen eingegangen werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bereichs „Compliance & Risikomanagement“ einschließlich der zugeordneten Beauftragtenfunktionen (z. B., WpHG-Compliance-, Beauftragter Regulatory Compliance, CISO, Risikocontrolling- und Auslagerungsbeauftragter)

  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Compliance-Funktion: Sicherstellung einer wirksamen Überwachung der Einhaltung wesentlicher gesetzlicher und aufsichtsrechtlicher Anforderungen

  • Etablierung bzw. Weiterentwicklung von Compliance-Standards und Richtlinien sowie Überwachung deren Einhaltung

  • Sicherstellung geeigneter Schlüsselkontrollen auf Basis risikoorientierter Überwachungspläne

  • Compliance-Risikomanagement mit Berichterstattung an das Management

  • Etablierung einer risikobewussten Unternehmenskultur („Compliance-Kultur“) mit entsprechenden Schulungen

  • Laufende Weiterentwicklung der Risikostrategie in Abstimmung mit dem Management

  • Laufendes Risikocontrolling von der Risikoinventur über die Entwicklung geeigneter Messmethoden bis zum laufenden Monitoring inkl. Stresstests

  • Überwachung der Risikotragfähigkeit

  • Regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Management

data.description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

At Zattoo, we bring linear TV to the internet and make it personal for millions of viewers across Europe. Many TV platforms, our own and those of our B2B partners, run on the same backend. The backend team builds and runs the services behind all of them.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll design and run the Python services and APIs that keep this experience fast and reliable, including at peak times like live sports finals. You'll work on a multi-tenant, distributed platform, so scalability, efficiency and maintainability matter in every design decision. You'll also help us keep improving the platform and the way we build it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Shape our API platform. Learn our multi-tenant, distributed web API infrastructure and help take it to the next level.
  • Build services that hold up under load. Design, develop and deploy backend services and API gateways for high availability, low latency and scale.
  • Own what you ship. Your team runs its own services in production, from deployment and monitoring to on-call and incident follow-up.
  • Enable the business. Build and maintain admin tools that let tenant-facing teams configure business logic for each tenant on their own.
  • Work across disciplines. Join an autonomous, cross-functional team and work closely with frontend, video and operations engineers to understand what they need from the backend.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 4+ years of professional Python experience, building highly available services and APIs that perform well under heavy load
  • Hands-on experience with Python web frameworks such as FastAPI, Sanic or Django
  • Experience with relational and non-relational data stores, for example PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis or Elasticsearch
  • Experience designing and running services in a distributed system
  • A DevOps mindset: you've deployed and run services in production, on-premises and/or in the cloud
  • A solid understanding of how web platforms work end to end, from the client request through the backend to the response
  • Fluent English, spoken and written

Bonus:

  • BSc. / MSc. degree in computer science or similar discipline
  • Async Python (asyncio) in production
  • Containers and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Experience with multi-tenant or white-label platforms
  • Experience migrating legacy systems to a new architecture
  • Background in media, streaming or video delivery

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate:trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.

Das ist unser Kunde

Unser Kunde ist ein inhabergeführtes Systemhaus im Bergischen Land mit Sitz zwischen Düsseldorf und Wuppertal. Seit über zehn Jahren kümmert sich das Team um die IT kleiner und mittelständischer Unternehmen in Wuppertal, Solingen, Remscheid, Düsseldorf und Umgebung. Code17 ist ein Engineering-Team aus Leipzig. Seit 2017 entwickeln wir Daten-, KI- und Softwarelösungen für Unternehmen aus der Energiewirtschaft.

Wir bringen Daten und KI aus dem Pilotprojekt in den produktiven Betrieb und bauen individuelle Systeme, wenn Standardsoftware nicht weit genug geht. Dabei arbeiten wir nach dem Prinzip Build to Own: Code, Modelle und Wissen bleiben beim Kunden.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kunden und ihren Entwickler- und Projektteams an realen technischen Problemen.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, Anforderungen einfach abzuarbeiten. Du verstehst, welches Problem wirklich gelöst werden muss, hinterfragst bestehende Annahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden die passende Lösung.

Das bringst du mit

Uns ist wichtiger, wie du denkst und arbeitest, als dass du jede Technologie bereits beherrschst.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

Erfahrung mit Rust, JavaScript / TypeScript, C++, Cloud-Plattformen, Kubernetes oder energiewirtschaftlichen Daten ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Du lernst unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und erste Kundenprojekte kennen und übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für konkrete technische Themen.

Unser Ziel ist nicht, dir dauerhaft einzelne Tickets zu geben. Du sollst Projekte und Probleme zunehmend selbst verstehen, eigene Lösungswege vorschlagen und gemeinsam mit Kunden und Team Entscheidungen treffen.

data.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Technical Program Manager (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

As a (Senior) Technical Program Manager (TPM) at RobCo, you take responsibility for overseeing and managing multiple complex robot deployment projects simultaneously. You actively contribute to shaping the structures and processes that drive our projects to success. Your goal is to ensure that all your projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and in line with the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Program Ownership: You are responsible for multiple strategically relevant robotics deployment programs simultaneously – from pre-sales alignment and technical solution design through implementation to successful handover into operational business.

  • Building Scalable Structures: You develop governance frameworks, reporting standards, and delivery processes that enable fast, high-quality growth. In doing so, you establish best practices for future programs.

  • Strategic Stakeholder Management: You act as a sparring partner to C-level executives, customers, and internal leadership teams. You create transparency regarding progress, risks, dependencies, and business impact, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Technical and Commercial Steering: You maintain oversight of both technical integration details and commercial aspects such as budgets, margins, resource planning, and business cases, ensuring projects are delivered successfully from a financial perspective.

  • Risk and Escalation Management: You identify systemic risks at an early stage, initiate preventive measures, and manage escalations in a structured and solution-oriented manner.

  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: You analyze recurring patterns, identify optimization potential, and actively drive automation and standardization of our deployment processes.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Excellent German and English language skills, both are critical.

  • Completed technical university degree (e.g., Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science) or equivalent qualification with significant technical professional experience

  • 5+ years of experience managing complex technical programs, ideally in robotics, automation, industrial tech, or hardware-software integration

  • Proven experience in building scalable project or deployment structures in a high-growth environment

  • Strong systems understanding of mechatronic or cyber-physical systems

  • Ability to abstract technical details to an executive level and translate them into business impact

  • Confident presence when interacting with customers, management, and external partners

  • Experience with budget responsibility, resource planning, and commercial management

  • Structured, data-driven working style combined with pragmatic execution skills

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Sales Team Lead is a pivotal commercial role responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a sales team. The position focuses on driving sales performance, optimizing pipeline management, and ensuring operational excellence to support sustainable revenue growth.

You will work closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to execute strategic initiatives, maintain KPI ownership, and foster a high-performance culture. This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys developing top talent, and brings a strong commercial mindset.

We offer a clear career growth path, competitive compensation with performance-based incentives, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact at our Berlin headquarters, backed by leading international investors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Performance & Operations

  • Drive commercial performance and contribute to sustainable revenue growth.

  • Lead day-to-day sales execution and monitor weekly and monthly KPIs.

  • Own pipeline management and ensure accurate, disciplined forecasting.

  • Maintain visibility over pipeline health, market developments, and overall sales performance.

  • Collaborate with Sales Leadership to improve sales processes and operational efficiency.

  • Implement and reinforce best practices, reporting standards, and performance tracking to ensure consistent execution.

2. Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead and inspire a high-performing sales team in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, setting clear expectations and standards for success.

  • Drive a strong performance culture built on accountability, consistency, and continuous improvement.

  • Coach and develop team members through regular 1:1s, deal reviews, live feedback, and hands-on support.

  • Partner with Sales Leadership on hiring, onboarding, and developing top talent to ensure long-term team strength.

  • Identify growth opportunities within the team and actively support career development and internal progression.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent achievement of sales targets and pipeline objectives.

  • A highly engaged and high-performing sales team.

  • Strong forecasting accuracy and operational discipline.

  • Improved sales productivity, conversion rates, and overall team efficiency.

Who You Are

  • 4–6+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or sales leadership roles.

  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, or coaching sales teams in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong understanding of sales KPIs, pipeline management, and sales operations.

  • Hands-on, proactive mindset with strong leadership and coaching capabilities.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems; experience with Salesforce is a plus.

  • Additional European language (German, Italian, or French) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a high-performance, office-based environment.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. Agicap is one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech scale-ups. Our platform helps mid-market companies manage cash, liquidity and financial operations, combining treasury management, accounts payable and accounts receivable in a single tool. Founded in Lyon in 2016, Agicap serves over 8,000 customers in twelve countries, with about 650 people across Lyon, Berlin, Milan, Madrid, Lisbon, London and the US.

Germany is one of our main markets. Our Berlin office at Moritzplatz is home to around 100 people, and DACH remains a top priority for our growth.


The role :

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to own hiring for our DACH scope from our Berlin office. You will run the full cycle, from hiring need to offer, for business roles in Germany, mainly Sales and Customer Success, plus a few senior or expert positions.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will be the go-to recruiter for DACH and a sparring partner on hiring plans and profiles. Reporting to the Global Head of TA, you will join a team that works across seven markets and shares playbooks, tools and projects.


What you'll do :

Hiring delivery

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for DACH roles: intake, job description, sourcing, screening, process management, closing and following offer.

  • Hit monthly hiring targets for Sales (SDR, Account Executive) and Customer Success roles, and take on senior or strategic DACH hires.

  • Source passive candidates proactively on LinkedIn and other channels, with sharp outreach in German and English.

  • Assess candidates against clear scorecards and coach them through each stage.

    • Partnering with the business

  • Act as a trusted advisor to DACH hiring managers and leaders: challenge profiles, set realistic hiring plans, and push for fast, fair decisions.

  • Bring market insight to every intake: talent availability, competitor landscape, salary benchmarks and candidate expectations in DACH.

    • Process, data and brand

  • Track and report your pipeline and KPIs: time-to-hire, conversion rates and quality of hire.

  • Spot friction in the candidate journey and interview process, then test and roll out improvements.

  • Strengthen Agicap's employer brand in Germany: content, referrals, events and partnerships.

  • Contribute to global TA projects, such as AI in recruiting, playbooks and onboarding of new recruiters.


    • What you bring :

    Must-haves

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting, ideally combining agency and in-house at a tech, SaaS or fintech scale-up.

  • Strong active-sourcing skills: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, a headhunter mindset.

  • Credibility with senior stakeholders: you can push back, influence and drive decisions.

  • A data-driven approach: you use funnel metrics to steer your work and your hiring managers.

  • Native or bilingual German and fluent English.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • A proven track record of hiring Sales and Customer Success profiles in Germany, at volume and at senior levels.

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in sourcing, screening or reporting.

  • Experience with Lever or a similar ATS.

  • Autonomous and hands-on: you own your scope without daily supervision.

Unsere Mission ist einfach: Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, Daten zu verstehen. Wir sind der Meinung, dass Unternehmen, die Daten sinnvoll einsetzen, bessere Zukunftsaussichten haben als andere und haben bereits Kunden wie PwC, Rheinenergie, Johnson & Johnson, Fielmann, Volkswagen und DZ Bank dabei geholfen, Datenvisualisierung und Datenintegration mit den führenden Produkten Tableau und Alteryx zu optimieren.
 
Als Consultant in The Data School bekommst du weit mehr als nur eine durchschnittliche Ausbildung. Du erhältst ein Gehalt, um dich von einigen der besten Datenexperten weltweit (darunter 6 Tableau Visionaries und zwei Alteryx ACEs) über Daten und Technologie weiterbilden zu lassen. Innerhalb von 4 Monaten erhältst du eine intensive und umfangreiche Ausbildung in unserer fantastischen Data School im Zentrum von Hamburg. Und das Beste daran? Du hast die Chance, dein neues Wissen und deine Fähigkeiten bei einigen der größten und bekanntesten Global Playern und beim Deutschen Mittelstand in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz und Großbritannien unter Beweis zu stellen.
 
Wir vermitteln nicht nur Technologie um ihrer selbst willen. Und wir unterrichten nicht auf irgendeine beliebige Art und Weise. Mit Unterstützung deiner Coaches und des gesamten Teams lernst du nicht nur, wie man Daten speichert, verwaltet und präsentiert, sondern auch persönliche Fähigkeiten, um dein Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und zu einem außergewöhnlichen Berater zu werden. Und all das in einer Umgebung, die außergewöhnlich inklusiv und kooperativ ist.
 
Du hast noch nie von Tableau oder Alteryx gehört? Kein Problem. Unsere Consultants haben verschiedene Hintergründe und viele von ihnen hatten noch nie von Tableau gehört, bevor sie auf uns gestoßen sind. Hier kannst du einige von ihnen kennenlernen. Was sie alle gemeinsam haben, ist jedoch ihre Leidenschaft für Problemlösung, insbesondere für Problemlösung mit Daten und Fakten. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

This position requires a motivated self-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into a geographic territory for Commercial Accounts, as defined by Delinea based on annual revenue of $500M or less.

About RhymeQ

RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming.

Your role

As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development.

You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size.

What you will do

  • Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME.
  • Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program.
  • Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation.
  • Create useful technical content: Develop tutorials, sample projects, livestreams, posts, and talks that make quantum programming approachable.
  • Support community contributions: Encourage developers to share their work, answer questions, and help others. Identify and support potential community ambassadors.
  • Connect developers with the product team: Turn questions, feedback, and recurring problems into clear recommendations for the compiler, tooling, and documentation.
  • Measure what works: Track acquisition, activation, retention, and contributions, and use the results to improve community programs.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s in computer science, PhD is preferred.
  • Over 2 years of experience growing a developer community for a technical product, with results you can demonstrate through active users, downloads, contributors, event participation, or other relevant measures.
  • Practical Python skills. You can run code examples, lead a live tutorial, and help a newcomer troubleshoot their setup.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and make learning engaging, whether in writing, on camera, or on stage.
  • Strong written and spoken English and confidence working with an international audience.
  • A self-driven approach: you can set priorities, organize programs, deliver them, and learn from the results.
  • An open, supportive communication style that helps developers feel comfortable asking questions and sharing unfinished work.
  • An understanding of quantum computing fundamentals, or the motivation to learn them quickly.

Your ability to build trust with developers, teach through code, and grow sustained participation matters most.

What we offer

  • Ownership from the start: Shape our community strategy, programs, and developer experience as our first community hire.
  • Direct collaboration with the founders: Work closely with the people building RHYME and bring developer needs into product decisions.
  • An open, international team: Share ideas, experiment, and learn alongside colleagues who value initiative and collaboration.
  • Visible impact: Help developers move from curiosity about quantum computing to building their own applications.
  • Remote work within Europe.

OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades: Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.

You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.

The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

  • Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

  • Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

  • Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

  • Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

  • Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

  • Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

  • Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

  • Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

  • Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

Must-Have Skills

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

  • Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

  • Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas, from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

  • Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products, including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Strong customer discovery and product judgment, with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment, with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

  • Proven cross-functional ownership, working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams.

  • English at C1 level and German at C2 level.

  • Willingness to stay close to customers and the team, including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI, particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows.

  • Experience with AI monetisation, including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models.

  • Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades.

  • Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits.

  • Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit.

You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new.

You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions.

You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.

And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world's smartphones, connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem.

Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Scalable Discovery & Engagement

The Data Science Research team builds foundational ML representations and advanced AI capabilities that enhance both Playtime and adjoe Ads. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI and deep learning approaches—specifically generative approaches —to deliver critical systems such as high-dimensional user embeddings, general content understanding and sequential recommendation. These frameworks scale adjoe's products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users.

The team operates at the intersection of bleeding-edge R&D and high-scale production engineering, acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser and primary consulting layer for complex ML bottlenecks. The stack is optimized for deep learning and heavy data throughput: PyTorch and [Ray/Hugging Face] for training and fine-tuning foundation models, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure for heavy workloads. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain high-throughput, realtime production environments.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics, or an MSc with extensive industry research, and publications in top-tier venues like SIGIR, KDD, NeurIPS, or ICLR. You've spent 4+ years building large-scale recommender systems in high-throughput environments: AdTech, e-commerce, or social.

  • You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting multi-stage recommendation pipelines, Generative Retrieval, Deep Ranking, and Re-ranking, serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users' behavioral data.

  • Deep expertise in PyTorch and large-scale model optimization. data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented AIT Test Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that NYX can be integrated.

You will be successful in this role if you are able to help us:

  • Prepare, execute and manage the internal or external dynamic testing (vibration test, shock tests,...) of several sub-systems (electronic, fittings, weldings...) and internally developed prototypes

  • Prepare, execute and manage the internal or external thermal testing (cycling, TVAC...) of several sub-systems and internally developed prototypes

  • Write documentation prior and post integration and test activities

  • Prepare, execute and manage other testing activities in AIT domain (e.g.: parachute, EMC, mechanisms, Structural Test Model...)

  • Support mechanical integration activities needed on Nyx Capsule


Key Responsibilities

  • You will manage the testing activities from definition of requirements to post-test reviews

  • You will be responsible of writing, reviewing and executing procedures detailing the setups for integration and tests (in Epsilon3, ODOO, Team Center)

  • You will be responsible for the execution of the tests performed in-house with internal equipment (vibration test bench, thermal vacuum chamber, shock test rig, ...)

  • You will be responsible for the execution of the tests performed in external facilities

  • You will be responsible of the procurement (or rental) of instrumentation and its installation on the items to test

  • You will be expected to interact with other AIT engineers and technicians but also with external stakeholders

  • You will be largely involved in the resolutions of anomalies happening during the integration and tests

  • You will manage the reports to be done at the end of the operations/tests

  • You will give your feedback and report on any blockage or problem during the testing and will work to propose improvements and fixes

  • You will be asked to support the qualification plans of new processes within AIT (welding, fittings...)

  • You will be supporting the Purchase of all the equipment (COTS or not) needed to run the testing activities (Tools, generic GSE)

  • You will be working with AIT technicians and MGSE team to define needs of machined parts and/or tools (proposing design, follow up with MGSE team)


Additional Requirements

  • Versatile, in order to support several activities depending on the workload

  • Being able to manage several topics at the same time (preparation of next tests and execution in parallel)

  • Proficient in following safety standards and maintaining quality control during all assembly and test operations.


Qualifications and experience

  • Engineering degree (Master or PhD) in mechanical science, instrumentation/test or equivalent

  • Experience in the AIT of aerospace vehicles

  • Prior experience with Vibration Tables, Thermal Chambers or similar equipment is a plus

  • Mechanical skills with electrical/digital and electromechanical knowledge would be appreciated


Skills and Behaviors

  • Leadership skills

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business in English

  • Organized and rigorous

  • Hands-on approach

  • Inventive and problem solver, team spirit

  • Able to document all tasks in written form

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Mission, Teamwork, Integrity and Excellence

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the team

We don’t build pricing models, we build the driving intelligence that feeds them. Our mission is to drive safer roads and fairer insurance through data.

The Telematics team transforms raw phone sensor data into meaningful insights about how people drive. Using advanced signal processing and machine learning, we process high-frequency data to extract behavioural signals that power our understanding of driving quality, context, and risk.

About the Role

As a Data Scientist, you’ll contribute to the future of behaviour-based insurance. You’ll contribute to the development of features and algorithms that detect driving patterns from sensors, test new hypotheses, and help bring impactful insights into production.

You’ll work closely at the intersection of data science and engineering, generating scalable, real-world insights from GPS, accelerometer, and other spatial data.

What you will be doing

  • Build and refine behavioural features and factors from telematics data.

  • Develop and maintain end-to-end pipelines in Python and SQL, ranging from simple heuristics to complex machine learning models.

  • Build robust solutions that scale, whether rule-based or ML-driven.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineers,Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement features and evaluate their impact.

  • Run experiments, test new ideas, and assist in automating insight generation.

  • Translate complex sensor data into clear insights that can shape our roadmap and product.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • MSc or BSc in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Statistics), or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on experience developing data science or data engineering solutions. You’re comfortable writing production-grade code, not just notebooks.

  • Solid skills in Python and SQL, including standard libraries (Polars, Scipy, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).

  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines and tools that are reliable and maintainable.

  • Clear communication skills: able to break down problems into testable hypotheses and collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

  • A growth mindset: curious, eager to learn from senior peers, and open to feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to noisy, high-frequency, or time-series sensor data (e.g., GPS, accelerometer).

  • Familiarity with digital signal processing or sensor physics principles.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and tools like Docker or basic pipeline orchestration.

  • Background or interest in insurance, mobile telemetry, or behavioural modeling.

  • Experience applying Deep Learning models to time-series data.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities.

 

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months.

If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you.
