data.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.


What You'll Do
  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.
  • Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.
  • Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.
  • Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.
  • Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.
  • Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.
  • Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.
  • Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

    • What You'll Bring
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.
  • Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.
  • Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.
  • Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).
  • Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.
  • Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.
  • Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team.
    • If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link.

    Why People Join Us

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. Ready to work somewhere that cares more about how you build software than how fast you can ship it?

At Opencast, we don’t measure developers by the number of tickets you complete. We care about engineering craft, clean design and thoughtful problem-solving. 

Opencast consultants deliver in complex environments, pairing often and working with others who take pride in doing things properly: TDD, emerging design, refactoring and leaving code better than they found it. We build software we are proud of, and our clients trust us not just to code but to think, challenge and guide. If you value simple and robust solutions and want a role where your judgment matters as much as your keyboard, you will fit right in.

The role

We’re looking for Contractors in Software Development (Senior level or Technical Lead) to help our major clients transform. 

Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, extreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation.

Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice.

Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority.

Contractors at Opencast follow the same principles as permanent consultants. The roles are varied, technical, and never confined to any one provider or solution.

Requirements

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must either currently hold active Security Check (SC) Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.

Eligibility typically requires UK citizenship and continuous residence in the UK for the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days.

As attendance at client sites is a routine part of the role’s working pattern and involves occasional travel, travel expenses are not covered.

Experience in delivering digital services for the UK government is highly valuable for many of our projects. Therefore, familiarity with the GDS toolkit will be beneficial.

Technical Skills

  • Expertise in Java and/or Scala is required
  • Experience in other languages such as Javascript, Typescript, Kotlin, Python or Ruby is also valuable
  • Experience in a technical leadership role
  • Deep understanding of programming paradigm, code design, testing, accessibility, performance and security
  • Proven ability to apply different testing tools and methods in practice
  • Knowledge or experience of delivering complex services to Government Digital Service (GDS) standards
  • Being comfortable with new technology, t-shaped and comfortable with ongoing learning and development is key to success
  • Experience with agile methodology

A contractor in software development at Opencast is responsible for:

  • Driving the elaboration of their team’s backlog
  • Setting testing strategies to match industry standards
  • Being a technical expert in their team (or acting as the team lead)
  • Leading the technical representation in a project discovery
  • Acting as a technical lead in the team, enabling them to achieve their full potential

Salary 

£450 - £600 per day (working inside IR35)

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it.

Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world's most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers. The challenge is not another chatbot. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, operate within real workflows, seek judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer's trust.

We have one value: velocity.

Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. Every builder on the team orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. That pace needs a designer whose thinking keeps up: someone who can go from a vague problem to a clear, high-fidelity answer in hours, not sprints, and put it in front of engineers and customers while the idea is still hot. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short.

What you'll design

Day to day, you'll own:

  • the look and feel of new product experiences across the hiring workflow, from first sketch to final pixels

  • interfaces that make AI agents feel transparent, trustworthy, and like a real coworker

  • the moments where conversational signal becomes something a user can see, trust, and act on

  • fast, high-fidelity prototypes that prove or kill an idea before anyone commits to building it

  • the craft bar for the whole product: motion, density, hierarchy, and the details that make it feel inevitable

What you'll own

In your first 3–6 months, you should:

  • own meaningful product areas end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout, in close partnership with engineering

  • set how Metaview's AI products look, feel, and behave in real customer workflows

  • turn messy, ambiguous problems into interfaces that feel obvious in hindsight

  • raise the bar across craft, execution, and product judgment

What we're after

We're likely to be excited by people who:

  • have designed and shipped beautiful, complex products in fast-moving software environments

  • are deep specialists in product design: interaction, visual craft, and systems thinking at the highest level

  • have a real point of view on products: what's great, what's broken, and what they'd change

  • care about the pixels, the motion, and the details most people never notice

  • like ownership, ambiguity, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product, and customers

  • want to help define what AI-native software feels like while the shape of the company is still being formed

What you bring

Helpful signals include experience with:

  • designing products where the pixels matter: rich, interactive, information-dense interfaces

  • design systems, real-time collaboration, or other hard interaction problems

  • AI-native interfaces: agent interactions, streaming and loading states, the in-between moments of a conversation

  • a portfolio that shows real obsession with craft, and the reasoning behind the decisions

  • startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high

What you want to know — San Francisco

  • A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook.

  • We pay in the top 10% of the SF market: salary plus meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct, and it's not unusual to hear back the same day.

  • Simplified leveling: early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games.

  • Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market twice a year and move comp up when it drifts, so "top 10%" stays true after your start date too.

  • Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. Raises are tied to a real change in the work, not an automatic bump.

  • Equity that's truly competitive. World-class option grants so we're all owners. The structure stays simple: cash and equity.

  • Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish.

  • Health, fully covered. 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, for you and your dependents.

  • Unlimited time off. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.

data.title: Business Operations Associate

data.description:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing.

This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows.

There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks.

  • Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered.

  • Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging.

  • Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery.

  • Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff.

  • Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns.

  • Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction.

  • Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as an interaction designer or senior UX designer with strong interaction design depth.

  • Ability to design at the micro level - states, transitions, edge cases, and failure handling.

  • Strong prototyping skills in Figma or equivalent tools.

  • Systematic thinking - able to map complex AI behavior into coherent user-facing interaction logic.

  • Clear understanding of HCI principles: user control, transparency, feedback, and graceful recovery.

  • Experience working closely with engineers to ensure interactions are implemented as designed.

  • Comfort designing for systems where output is non-deterministic and behavior can vary across sessions.

  • Strong judgment on when users should be guided, interrupted, asked for confirmation, or left alone.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

Talent Acquisition Partner

Help take Solve Intelligence 3x in a single year. We’re looking for a recruiter with strong engineering hiring experience who wants to recruit across the business and help build our talent function.

🏗️ About the role

You’ll be an early hire in our talent team, owning searches from first outreach through to signed offer. Engineering recruitment will be a core part of your remit, alongside GTM, legal, operations and other functions as the business grows. You’ll need to enjoy that breadth and get to grips with unfamiliar roles quickly.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Running multiple searches across engineering, AI research, GTM, legal and operations, from understanding the requirements to closing the offer.

  • Building pipelines through direct sourcing, using targeted outreach and newer AI sourcing tools to find candidates beyond inbound applications and agencies.

  • Deciding which searches need your attention most, understanding the business priorities behind them, and flagging risks early.

  • Working with hiring managers to define what each role requires and design assessments that help us make hiring decisions. You’ll need enough technical understanding to assess engineering candidates and discuss your judgement with the team.

  • Improving hiring quality and offer acceptance by understanding candidates’ motivations early and closing people with competing offers.

  • Keeping candidates informed throughout the process, with thoughtful outreach, timely updates and honest communication.

  • Helping build the talent function: keeping Ashby accurate, improving workflows and contributing to projects beyond your own searches.

🚀 Who you are

You’ve hired frontend, backend, full-stack and AI engineers, and you understand the differences between those searches. You can read a technical CV critically and hold a substantive first conversation with an engineer.

Your recent experience is either in-house at an early-stage startup or at a recruitment firm working with technical companies that set a high hiring bar. You’re comfortable working with limited support and deciding what needs your attention without waiting for direction.

You care about how recruitment is run. That shows in the outreach you send and the assessment notes hiring managers use to make decisions. You keep Ashby up to date, and candidates know where they stand.

🛠️ What you bring

Must haves

  • Direct experience hiring frontend, backend, full-stack and AI engineers.

  • Recent success in an in-house talent role at an early-stage startup, ideally VC-backed, with minimal support; or at a recruitment firm working with technical companies with a high hiring bar.

  • Experience using Ashby, ideally including improving how it is configured or used.

  • Hands-on sourcing experience and the ability to build a pipeline from scratch.

  • Fluency with newer AI sourcing tools, beyond LinkedIn Recruiter.

  • Strong written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should be good enough to share as examples.

  • Demonstrated ability to close candidates with competing offers.

  • The ability to pick up new roles, understand requirements quickly and build processes from scratch.

Nice to haves

  • An agency or search firm background earlier in your career.

  • Experience building AI-powered recruiting workflows.

  • Experience hiring across multiple countries.

🎁 What we offer

  • £70,000 – £110,000 base salary depending on experience

  • Significant equity; we want you to take real ownership in Solve Intelligence

  • Full visa sponsorship

  • Opportunity to help build the talent function of a generational AI company

  • Private medical insurance

  • Free meals

🚀 About Solve Intelligence

Solve Intelligence is the fastest-growing startup transforming the IP landscape. Solve's AI platform manages everything from invention harvesting and patent generation through to litigation and licensing.

Growth: 20–30% MoM revenue growth; selling to 700+ global IP teams across 6 continents (DLA Piper, tech giants, boutiques, etc); 8 figures of ARR — all just ~2 years since we started.

Backing: $55M backing from YC, 20VC, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and the founders of top companies like Stripe, Perplexity, Tinder, Deel, Hugging Face, and Canva.

Impact: 50–90% efficiency and quality improvements.

See our latest Series B announcement.

We're on a high-growth trajectory, and we're looking for people who want to join us on the journey to building a generational AI company.

Come join the rocket ship 🚀

👥 Meet the founders

Sanj (Chief Research Officer and Co-Founder): Sanj did his MSci in Physics at the University of Cambridge and his PhD in AI at the Gatsby Unit, UCL. He won awards at top AI conferences, worked on the R&D team at Huawei, and received widespread attention for his contributions to open-source LLM projects on GitHub. He joined Magic Carpet AI as employee #4, where he developed AI strategies for trading, before the company was acquired.

Chris (Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder): Chris did his undergrad at Imperial College London, his masters at the University of Cambridge, and his PhD in machine learning at UCL, during which he published 10+ papers and won awards at top AI conferences and journals. Prior to founding Solve, Chris worked at The Alan Turing Institute, InstaDeep, and Dyson.

Angus (Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder): Angus holds an MEng in Computer Science. He led trade platform development at Coremont after roles at GCHQ and Qualcomm.

data.description:
À propos de Symrise

Symrise est un fournisseur mondial de fragrances, de parfums, d'arômes, d'ingrédients actifs cosmétiques et d'ingrédients fonctionnels. L'entreprise compte parmi les leaders mondiaux de son secteur et dessert des fabricants de parfums, de cosmétiques, de produits alimentaires et de boissons, ainsi que l'industrie pharmaceutique et les producteurs de compléments nutritionnels et d'aliments pour animaux.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) au Secrétaire Général, avec un rattachement fonctionnel au Regional Head of Safety EAME, vous définissez, pilotez et faites évoluer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy.

Véritable partenaire de la Direction du site et des responsables opérationnels, vous veillez à intégrer pleinement les enjeux EHS aussi bien dans les activités quotidiennes que dans les projets de transformation, de développement et d'investissement du site.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

  • Définir et déployer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy, en cohérence avec les objectifs EHS globaux de Symrise et les priorités du business.

  • Manager et développer l'équipe EHS, en définissant les priorités et en veillant à disposer des compétences et ressources nécessaires.

  • Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les principaux risques environnementaux, santé et sécurité, et assurer la mise en œuvre de plans de prévention adaptés.

  • Développer une véritable culture de la sécurité et de la prévention auprès de l'ensemble des activités du site : laboratoires, bureaux et fonctions support.

  • Accompagner la Direction dans ses prises de décision en apportant votre expertise sur les risques EHS, les contraintes réglementaires et leurs impacts opérationnels.

  • Intégrer les exigences EHS dès les premières étapes des projets de transformation, immobiliers, laboratoires et de développement du site.

  • Piloter la conformité réglementaire et anticiper les évolutions de la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'EHS susceptibles d'impacter les activités du site.

  • Développer et entretenir des relations constructives avec les autorités et parties prenantes externes, notamment l'Inspection du travail, la CRAMIF, les services de santé au travail ainsi que les autorités environnementales et locales.

  • Représenter le site lors des inspections et audits réglementaires et assurer le suivi des plans d'action associés.

  • Piloter les analyses d'incidents et garantir la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives et préventives durables.

  • Suivre la performance EHS, les indicateurs clés et le reporting associé, dans une logique d'amélioration continue.

  • Être l'interface privilégiée entre le site de Clichy et les équipes EHS régionales et globales de Symrise.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Hygiène, Sécurité et Environnement (HSE/EHS), sciences environnementales, ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe.

Vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience progressive dans une fonction EHS, idéalement acquise au sein d'une organisation internationale et dans des environnements complexes combinant activités industrielles, laboratoires ou opérations.

Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons un profil capable d'allier vision stratégique et pragmatisme opérationnel.

Vous vous distinguez notamment par :

  • Une solide expertise en management EHS, évaluation des risques et conformité réglementaire.

  • Une expérience confirmée dans le management et le développement d'équipes EHS.

  • Une expérience significative dans l'accompagnement de projets de transformation, de développement ou d'investissement.

  • Une bonne maîtrise des relations avec les autorités réglementaires et les parties prenantes externes.

  • Une capacité à anticiper les risques et à transformer des problématiques EHS complexes en recommandations concrètes et pragmatiques pour le business.

  • De solides compétences en leadership, en influence et en accompagnement du changement dans une organisation matricielle et internationale.

  • Une excellente capacité à communiquer et à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment avec le senior management.

  • De fortes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'aide à la décision.

  • Une expérience en conduite du changement et en gouvernance de projets.

  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais.

Avantages

Ce poste vous offre l'opportunité de prendre la responsabilité des enjeux EHS au sein d'un site stratégique de Symrise, en collaboration étroite avec la Direction locale ainsi qu'avec les équipes régionales et globales du Groupe.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement en transformation, où l'EHS joue un rôle essentiel dans la continuité des activités, le développement du site, l'excellence opérationnelle et la croissance durable.

Au-delà des enjeux de conformité, vous aurez l'opportunité de façonner la feuille de route EHS du site de Clichy, d'influencer des décisions structurantes et de contribuer directement au développement d'une culture forte et proactive de la sécurité.

Localisation : Clichy (92)
Intitulé : EHS Manager – Site de Clichy

Rémunération

La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de EUR 60,000–72,000 par an.

Vos premiers mois chez Symrise

Vous prenez en main la gestion des dossiers HSE du site de Clichy et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles. Votre période d'essai de 3 mois vous permet de vous familiariser avec nos standards de sécurité et nos exigences réglementaires. Vous disposez de 25 jours de congés payés par an pour organiser votre équilibre personnel.

Au sein d'une équipe sécurité, en charge de protéger la donnée de l'entreprise, vous interviendrez pour renforcer la maîtrise de la surface d’exposition Internet de l’organisation. Une solution d’Attack Surface Management (ASM) est déjà déployée.

Vous serez amené à définir et mettre en œuvre la feuille de route.

  • Réaliser l’état des lieux : analyser les processus existants (RACI), l’outillage utilisé par les équipes et les lacunes de couverture sécurité

  • Définir et faire valider la feuille de route : fixer l’objectif du projet, ses étapes et ses livrables, avec la plus-value sécurité de chacun, puis obtenir la validation du management sécurité

  • Fiabiliser le référentiel des actifs exposés : exploiter et optimiser la solution ASM pour découvrir les actifs visibles sur Internet et tenir à jour le référentiel des publications externes (domaines, sous-domaines, services associés)

  • Automatiser l’analyse d’impact des détections : évaluer la criticité de chaque détection en croisant données techniques, dépendances et contexte métier

  • Prioriser et piloter les remédiations : classer les risques selon l’exposition, l’exploitabilité et l’impact potentiel, accompagner les équipes techniques et vérifier l’efficacité des corrections

  • Suivre la performance par des indicateurs : définir et améliorer les indicateurs opérationnels pour mesurer les risques, suivre leur évolution et évaluer l’efficacité des remédiations

  • Renforcer en continu la sécurité DNS : faire évoluer les méthodes d’analyse et les contrôles DNS dans une logique d’amélioration continue

Vos compétences

Compétences techniques

  • Solutions ASM / EASM, idéalement Hardenize de Red Shift

  • DNS (zones, DNSSEC, CAA), cycle de vie des domaines, registrars

  • Messagerie : SPF, DKIM, DMARC

  • Gestion des vulnérabilités et scoring (CVSS, EPSS, KEV)

  • Automatisation (N8N, scripts, API) et reporting (Power BI, Splunk)

Compétences transverses

  • Conduite de projet et animation d’équipes techniques

  • Capacité à convaincre et à accompagner jusqu’à la correction effective

  • Esprit de synthèse et aisance dans la communication au management

Avantages

We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

  • Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A).

We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year:

  • 5 weeks of paid time off;

  • 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

  • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

  • Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home.

  • Help with French paperwork like opening a French social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare), and more.

  • French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life.

Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

You’ll be reaching out to prospects across every level - from procurement managers and lead engineers to heads of anti-fraud, platform owners, CTOs, CPOs, and even CEOs. About us

Procurement is overdue for a reset. For years, procurement and accounting teams have been stuck on legacy platforms that are now trying to bolt AI onto decades-old architecture. The rest of the enterprise tech stack is speeding companies up, and procurement is still slowing them down.

Pivot is the AI-native intake-to-pay platform built to change that. It’s the procurement platform people across the business actually use, so adoption sticks, cycle times drop, and finance sees spend before it’s committed, not after. And because Pivot touches every team in a purchase, accounting teams can finally fully automate their boring tasks.

The adventure started mid-2023 with three founders, former C-levels from fintech unicorns (Qonto, Swile, and Nuxeo).

We’ve built a team of 70 operating across 25+ countries. Backed by $70M from tier-1 investors and trusted by DoorDash, Lemonade, Wolt and Flix, we’ve just moved into the enterprise, and we’re only getting started.


We're looking for smart, execution-driven people who care about building something exceptional.

Your role

As an Account Executive - Enterprise, you will own the full sales cycle for our most strategic accounts on the French and Belgium market. You will target large, complex organisations with multiple stakeholders, navigate sophisticated procurement and legal processes, and close high-value, long-term deals that define Pivot's enterprise footprint in EMEA.

You will join our Sales team, which currently includes a VP of Revenue, Account Executives, a Pre-Sales Engineer, and a BDR team. You will report directly to VP of Revenue.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from first contact through close, managing procurement, legal, IT, and C-suite stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan targeting strategic enterprise accounts across your defined region, in close coordination with the BDR team. Willing to open doors by your own methods too.

  • Build and deliver compelling business cases, executive-level presentations, and tailored demos that articulate Pivot's value at every stage of the buying journey.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, structure commercial agreements, and ensure favourable terms for both Pivot and clients, building win-win partnerships designed to last.

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts, surfacing upsell and cross-sell potential to grow revenue and deepen relationships.

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline: own your forecast with accuracy on a monthly and quarterly basis, and manage CRM hygiene in HubSpot.

  • Collaborate internally:

    • Work closely with the BDR team, providing direction, feedback, and mentorship to maximise the quality and volume of enterprise pipeline.

    • Partner with Pre-Sales to manage technical evaluations, RFPs, and InfoSec requirements during complex sales cycles.

    • Coordinate with the Operations team to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term client satisfaction post-close.

Your sales mindset

  • You are a master of enterprise sales cycles: multi-threaded stakeholder management and driving consensus across large, complex organisations come naturally to you.

  • You are a strategic thinker who approaches your territory like a business: mapping white space, prioritising high-potential accounts, and building plans to convert them methodically over time.

  • You are confident and credible at C-suite level, able to engage procurement directors and CFOs.

  • You are resilient and persistent: long sales cycles don't discourage you. You manage momentum, keep deals alive, and know how to re-engage accounts that have gone quiet.

  • You are naturally curious and want to actively solve customer problems.

  • You are commercially sharp, able to understand complex pricing structures and articulate ROI and TCO in a way that resonates with financially-driven buyers.

  • You are a collaborative leader who uplifts those around you: sharing knowledge with BDRs, working closely with pre-sales, and contributing to a culture of high performance.

  • You like solving problems and making complex things look simple.

  • You always want to keep learning and you are comfortable with confronting ideas.

  • You enjoy the cadence and want to bring the best of yourself within an early-staged startup.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing enterprise-level deals.

  • Demonstrated success selling to enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees), managing multi-stakeholder buying processes and complex procurement cycles.

  • Experience handling deals with ACV of £100k+ and sales cycles of 6–12+ months.

  • Native-level French, and Fluent-level English; additional languages (German, Spanish) are a strong plus.

  • Highly organised, data-driven, and comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.


We are looking for a Confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Care team at BlaBlaCar.

As part of the Corporate Services pillar, your mission will be to empower our Community Relations Team (CRT) with the tools they need to have a 360-degree view of the user journey across our platform. 

The Care team's primary objective is to build "Phoenix," our new, comprehensive back-office system. This service aggregates data from all other teams and supply lines (train, carpool, and bus), while also providing critical action capabilities regarding our users, such as account blocking and content moderation. 

Your role will be to contribute to the creation of this unified back-office and to ensure our customer relation agents can operate seamlessly. 

You will work within a multi-stack team of 3 Backend & 1 Frontend Engineer. You will collaborate closely with the Community Relations Team (CRT) as well as with Product Managers from other teams to best define needs and ensure seamless integration across the company.



Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve the services of the BlaBlaCar Backoffice

  • Maintain some strategic user features like the claim management and reporting systems of the BlaBlaCar platform

  • Take full ownership of substantial features, from technical design and implementation to deployment and monitoring

  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and other engineers to refine requirements and translate business needs into robust technical solutions

  • Uphold and improve the team's code quality standards, providing detailed feedback and mentorship through code reviews

  • Document the solutions we build and ensure our APIs and services are well understood by consumer teams

  • You have solid experience from companies with a strong engineering culture, within a growth context

L'Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, elle contribue à sécuriser les échanges de données de santé, à développer l'interopérabilité et à promouvoir des services numériques au bénéfice des professionnels et des usagers.

Au cœur de ces enjeux, Pro Santé Connect (PSC) est le service de fédération d'identité du secteur de la santé. Il permet aux professionnels d'accéder de manière sécurisée aux services numériques de santé grâce à une authentification adaptée à leurs besoins. Pour accompagner le développement de cet écosystème, l'ANS développe l'Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect (EDC PSC). Ce dispositif vise à permettre aux solutions numériques en santé de se raccorder à Pro Santé Connect et à leurs utilisateurs d'accéder aux services numériques dans des conditions maîtrisées de sécurité et de confiance. Il repose sur plusieurs dimensions complémentaires : interopérabilité technique, exigences de sécurité, référencement, qualification, accompagnement des acteurs et surveillance dans la durée.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable de projet transverse, chargé(e) de porter la vision globale de l'Espace de confiance et d'en coordonner le développement et le fonctionnement.

🎯 Vos missions

En tant que Responsable de projet transverse, vous êtes garant(e) de la cohérence globale de l'Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect. Vous définissez sa trajectoire, coordonnez les différentes expertises mobilisées et veillez au bon fonctionnement de l'ensemble du dispositif.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Définissez et portez la vision du dispositif : construisez la vision cible et pilotez la feuille de route de l'Espace de confiance.

  • Garantissez sa cohérence globale : veillez à l'articulation entre les référentiels, les parcours de référencement, les services techniques et le fonctionnement opérationnel.

  • Coordonnez les différents chantiers : organisez les dépendances, facilitez la collaboration entre les parties prenantes et veillez à la bonne articulation de leurs contributions.

  • Pilotez le fonctionnement du dispositif : consolidez les indicateurs de suivi, identifiez les points de vigilance et préparez les décisions et arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Animez la gouvernance : organisez le fonctionnement global de l'Espace de confiance et contribuez aux instances de pilotage.

  • Pilotez l'amélioration continue : organisez la collecte et la prise en compte des retours des éditeurs et partenaires afin de faire évoluer le dispositif.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement qui distingue volontairement la définition des exigences, l'accompagnement des acteurs, l'évaluation de conformité, l'expertise et la décision de référencement. Cette organisation vise à garantir l'impartialité et la confiance dans le dispositif.


💼 Votre profil

  • Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée d’au moins 5 ans dans le pilotage de projets, produits, services ou programmes numériques complexes, impliquant plusieurs expertises et parties prenantes.

Vous êtes notamment reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à :

  • Construire une vision cible, définir des orientations et élaborer une feuille de route

  • Piloter des sujets transverses et coordonner plusieurs chantiers interdépendants

  • Faire travailler ensemble des équipes et des organisations aux expertises variées

  • Identifier les dépendances, prioriser les actions et préparer les arbitrages

  • Assurer le suivi d'un dispositif à travers des indicateurs pertinents et des instances de gouvernance

  • Communiquer avec clarté, synthétiser des sujets complexes et adapter votre discours à des interlocuteurs spécialistes comme non spécialistes

Vous disposez également d'une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à l'identité numérique, à l'authentification, à la cybersécurité et à l'interopérabilité

Les connaissances suivantes seraient un plus :

  • Le secteur du numérique en santé et ses principaux acteurs institutionnels

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join Vibe's Talent Acquisition team inside the People org, initially reporting directly to Nicholas Wagner, Chief People Officer. The team owns hiring across Vibe as it pushes toward its 2030 growth targets, and this role is being created to give that effort an extra dedicated pair of hands in Paris. You'll get real ownership from day one: full-cycle recruiting on technical roles, direct partnership with hiring managers, and a seat at the table as the team builds. If you want to grow into a senior/lead technical recruiter inside a team that still feels small enough for your work to be visible, this is a good place to do it.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Engineering and Product roles, from intake to offer.

  • Build sourcing pipelines for specialized technical profiles, including Data and ML roles.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements before opening a search.

  • Run structured candidate conversations that give hiring managers real signal.

  • Keep candidates informed and engaged at every stage of the process.

  • Track pipeline health and flag bottlenecks before they slow a search down.

  • Represent Vibe's culture and mission to candidates considering multiple offers.

     

What You Need

  • 8+ years of experience running full-cycle technical recruiting in a fast-growing company.

  • You've built candidate pipelines for specialized or hard-to-fill technical roles.

  • You've managed a hiring process end to end, from outreach through offer.

  • You communicate clearly with both candidates and engineering hiring managers.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Experience recruiting in the streaming TV advertising or connected TV (CTV) space.

  • A network within the Paris or broader European tech ecosystem.

  • Proven experience on Ashby ATS.

     

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

 

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €60k–€90k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

 

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

     

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Live technical discussion — 60 min. A real Vibe search, worked through live with us: search strategy, candidate calibration, pipeline diagnosis. No take-home, no homework.

  • Engineering partner interview — 30 min. A live role intake with one of our engineering leaders.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely.

The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists.

Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less.

  • Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios.

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

Zur Erweiterung unseres Netzwerks suchen wir laufend erfahrene technische IAM Spezialisten für zukünftige Projekte und Positionen bei unseren Kunden.

Aktuell handelt es sich um keinen konkreten Einsatz. Mit deiner Bewerbung nimmst du unseren Talent Pool auf und wir kontaktieren dich, sobald wir eine Position haben, die zu deinem Profil und deinen Vorstellungen passt.

Mögliche Aufgaben:

  • Implementierung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung von Identity & Access Management Lösungen

  • Integration von Applikationen sowie Cloud- und On-Premises-Systemen

  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Provisionierungs- und Synchronisationsprozessen

  • Umsetzung von Single Sign-On (SSO) und Multi-Faktor-Authentifizierung (MFA)

  • Anbindung von Verzeichnisdiensten und Unternehmensapplikationen

  • Mitarbeit in IAM-, PAM- und Security-Projekten

  • Analyse technischer Anforderungen und Erarbeitung von Lösungskonzepten

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Infrastruktur-, Security- und Applikationsteams


Das bringst du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als technischer IAM Spezialist oder IAM Engineer

  • Erfahrung mit einer oder mehreren IAM-Lösungen wie Okta, Ping Identity, SailPoint, One Identity, Omada oder vergleichbaren Plattformen

  • Erfahrung in der Integration von Anwendungen und Identitätssystemen

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Authentifizierungs- und Autorisierungsstandards wie SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, LDAP oder SCIM

  • Erfahrung im Bereich Privileged Access Management (PAM) sowie mit gängigen Lösungen wie CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust oder vergleichbaren Produkten

  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Active Directory und/oder Microsoft Entra ID

  • Analytische, strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Das erwartet dich:

  • Zugang zu spannenden zukünftigen Projekten

  • Persönliche Betreuung während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses

  • Einsatzmöglichkeiten in modernen IAM- und Security-Umgebungen

  • Positionen passend zu deinen fachlichen und persönlichen Zielen

  • Diskrete und vertrauliche Behandlung deiner Bewerbung

Interessiert?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Nach einem ersten Kennenlernen nehmen wir dich in unseren Talent Pool auf und kontaktieren dich, sobald wir eine passende Möglichkeit für dich haben.

data.description:
Wir suchen Data & AI Engineers zur Unterstützung bei der Migration und Modernisierung groß angelegter Data-Warehouse-Umgebungen mithilfe LLM-gestützter Workflows. Die Rolle verbindet angewandtes Machine Learning, Data Engineering und Software Engineering mit einem starken Fokus auf die Entwicklung zuverlässiger, produktionsreifer LLM-basierter Systeme für Datentransformation, Validierung und Automatisierung.

Es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine Forschungsrolle. Der Erfolg wird daran gemessen, robuste Systeme zu entwickeln und in den produktiven Einsatz zu bringen, die reale Workflows auf Datenplattformen verbessern und automatisieren.

Wir freuen uns, Dich für zukünftige spannende Data-Engineering/LLM-Projekte in der Schweiz in unseren Talentpool aufzunehmen. Die Projekte werden sich in absehbarer Zeit weiter konkretisieren und bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen im zukunftsorientierten Bereich der LLM-Technologien zu sammeln.

 

Hauptaufgaben

  • Konzeption und Entwicklung LLM-gestützter Systeme zur Unterstützung von Data-Warehouse-Migrations- und Transformationsprozessen

  • Entwicklung interner Tools und Workflows unter Einsatz von LLMs für die Generierung und Übersetzung von Datenflüssen (z.B. SQL, Spark, Flink, Kafka, dbt), Schema-Übersetzung und Datenvalidierung

  • Konzeption und Implementierung von Evaluierungsframeworks für LLM-generierte Ergebnisse, z. B. ausführungsbasierte Prüfungen, Assertions und diff-basierte Validierung

  • Aufbau und Betreuung von Datenpipelines und Orchestrierungs-Workflows in produktiven Umgebungen

  • Optimierung und Fehleranalyse groß angelegter Datenverarbeitungssysteme in verteilten Umgebungen

  • Einsatz von agentenbasierten Ansätzen und Tool-Use-Patterns, wo sinnvoll, mit Fokus auf zuverlässige und kontrollierte Ausführung

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Data Engineers und Platform Teams zur Modernisierung bestehender Legacy-Data-Warehouse-Systeme


Profil

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von ML-/LLM-basierten Produkten oder internen Tools; Erfahrung mit dem produktiven Einsatz solcher Systeme ist zwingend erforderlich.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning oder Statistik, einschließlich Feature Engineering, Evaluierungsmethoden und Versuchsdesign.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Data-Warehouse- oder Big-Data-Systemen, z.B. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Teradata, Oracle, Spark oder Kafka

  • Analyse von Legacy-Quellen (COBOL, SAS, JCL, DB2) mit LLM-Unterstützung; Interesse an Legacy-Code vorausgesetzt

  • Erfahrung im operativen Einsatz von Tools zur Orchestrierung von Datenpipelines, z. B. Airflow oder Dagster

  • Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit mindestens einem weiteren Framework zur Datenverarbeitung (z.B. Spark, Flink, dbt) sowie ein gutes Verständnis der Prinzipien des Analytics Engineering

  • Erfahrung mit Best Practices im Software Engineering, insbesondere:

    • Git-based workflows

    • CI/CD pipelines

    • Infrastructure-as-code concepts

  • Vertrautheit mit LLM-Workflows:

    • Prompt Engineering

    • Verarbeitung und Parsing strukturierter Ausgaben

    • Token- und Kostenmanagement

    • Auswahl geeigneter Modelle und Abwägung von Vor- und Nachteilen

    • Entwicklung robuster Evaluierungsstrategien

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior System Engineer, der die Gestaltung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datacenter-Umgebungen aktiv mitgestaltet. In dieser Position verbindest du fundiertes technisches Know-how mit operativer Verantwortung und treibst die Automatisierung, Optimierung von Services sowie die Weiterentwicklung zuverlässiger Infrastruktur-Lösungen voran.

Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für definierte Infrastrukturplattformen, Services und Kundenumgebungen und fungierst als kompetente technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit, Leistungsfähigkeit und Sicherheit der Datacenter-Systeme und Managed Services sicher und optimierst diese kontinuierlich.

  • Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Effizienzsteigerung durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse.

  • Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Infrastruktur-Services aktiv mit – von technischen Konzepten über Service-Vorlagen bis hin zu Self-Service-Lösungen.

  • Du koordinierst die Bearbeitung komplexer Incidents, Service Requests und Infrastrukturänderungen und bringst dich zudem im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support, in Kundenprojekten sowie beim Wissensaustausch ein.

Anforderungen & Qualifikationen

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, IT oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Eine weiterführende technische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Datacenter-Umfeld mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Windows Server, Virtualisierung und komplexe Unternehmensinfrastrukturen.

  • Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Backup & Recovery, Netzwerktechnologien und Infrastruktur-Lösungen. Erfahrung mit Veeam oder Fortinet ist ein Plus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support und verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz und Systemverfügbarkeit.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, verfügst über ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und hast Freude an Automatisierung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und technischer Verantwortung.

Benefits & Unternehmenskultur

  • Ein kollegiales und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, Wissensaustausch und gemeinsamer Erfolg gefördert werden.

  • Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch Weiterbildungen, technische Schulungen und neue Herausforderungen.

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, eine positive Teamkultur und attraktive Zusatzleistungen, die eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance unterstützen.

data.description:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet
At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers.

The Solution Sales function is responsible for driving growth in specific lines of business. Interpreting and defining client needs in order to align the client’s objectives and requirements with Dun & Bradstreet’s products’ capabilities and value. 
 
In this role, you will work in partnership with the Relationship Manager and Client Success team, act as a senior specialist in our product offerings, supporting the Relationship Manager by conducting live product demonstrations via web-based meetings, in-person meetings, and through providing collateral to support driving Cross Sell, Upsell and New Business. 

Key Responsibilities:
  • Fulfill the role of trusted advisor on Dun & Bradstreet solutions through strategic conversations to understand organizational business objectives and goals.
  • Working in conjunction with a frontline sales team, actively manage the evaluation stage of the sales process and serve as the technical advisor for Dun & Bradstreet’s product suite. 
  • Assist with client facing demonstrations by clearly articulating underlying methodologies, while providing guidance on how the product functionality helps to improve organizational efficiencies.
  • Actively participate in account planning for assigned accounts, provide industry trends and assist with client/market segmentation of Dun & Bradstreet’s products.
  • Capture solution insights based on competitive analysis and client meetings; share insights with internal product teams during product design and development cycles.
  • Mapping out of customer use case journeys, identifying pain points, and proposing solutions by conducting product demonstrations, workshops, and POCs to showcase the capabilities and value of our solutions.
  • Be a respected subject matter expert for assigned solution(s); discuss product strategy and roadmaps in the context of market and technology trends.
  • Demonstrate product capabilities, overcome client objections and create a client specific buying vision.
  • Maintain and grow revenue stream through successful interpreting and defining client needs to align the client’s objectives and business requirements with Dun & Bradstreet’s products’ capabilities and value.
  • Support sellers in effectively packaging, pricing and presenting solutions to clients including return on investment.
  • Maintain consistent and accurate data in relevant CRM software (e.g. SFDC) and other sales tools to support territory, account planning and forecasting.
  • Ensure compliance with all business initiatives.
  • Serve as a thought leader in the industry, staying up-to-date with market trends, competitors, and emerging technologies.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote D&B's offerings.

    • Essential Skills:
  • Minimum of five (5) years prior experience in customer facing Field sales role selling new solutions to clients and generating significant revenue growth.
  • Customer centric with a proactive attitude to tackle problems and deliver solutions for great customer experience at scale for large companies during the whole customer journey

  • Experienced communicator when managing customers at different organisational levels.
  • High aptitude to stay current and train on related technology areas
  • Adept at providing technical solutions based on clients’ needs per the practice area
  • Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., SFDC) and Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Compliance with industry professional certifications is required when selling specific regulated financial or data products
  • Able and willing to mentor and support other members of the team
  • Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.
  • Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.
